# Explicit native addition followed by an existing terminal repair

Use this bounded chain only when the source-backed native addition has its own unchanged native topology proof, followed by an independently planned collinear retreat of an existing terminal line. The immutable supplied original remains assignment authority. Never substitute the derivative as `original_assignment`, reclassify the existing repair as topology removal to evade its style check, widen the mask after a failure, or count a source16x comparison as the required final2x comparison.

The observed T42 defect in the whole-ROI width statistic is specific: disconnected stray-tip fragments beyond a red-owned junction contributed narrow medial-ridge samples, changing the ROI median when removed. Actual source13 and28 are two nearly coincident green paints, both 3pt. At actual2x, the old statistic reported6→10.7703px despite unchanged retained stem width. The old2x and4x FAIL reports stay retained. This is a proven estimator defect, not permission to ignore any failure.

`validate_mixed_chain.py PLAN.json EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY` runs the original native topology verifier unchanged on original→addition, then replays exact independently reviewed terminal operations into that stage. It requires unchanged native styles, all prior vertices, actual source content, glyphs and final geometry; actual1x2x4x final equality with the composed expected PDF; and zero repair pixels outside the fixed source-bound mask. Repair and addition regions must not overlap. Multiple native views and other repair geometry are currently unsupported and fail explicitly.

The existing comparator runs freshly at actual2x and4x. Only its contaminated width statistic can be replaced, and only with an independently accepted, exact-hash implementation of `matched_width.py`. The new estimator uses every 0.25px station along the original/planned common terminal segment, selects eligible stations from original core ink only, and samples the connected normal section containing that same anchor in both renders at 0.05px. The **maximum** paired width difference must be≤1.25px at both scales. Insufficient stations and clipped profiles fail. Every changed native paint must map to an explicit palette status that receives every historical color/edge/texture/centerline/seam/status check. No threshold, palette-distance or sampling overrides are allowed. Exact native style proof is mandatory: narrowing one of two coincident green paints can remain visually hidden by the other.

The plan schema is `mixed-native-existing-chain-1`. Hash-bind these `{path,sha256}` records: `addition_plan`, `original_textfree`, `addition_source`, `original_layout_final`, `addition_final`, `repaired_source`, `final_pdf`, `repair_origin`, `independent_repair_review`, `estimator_diagnosis`, and `independent_estimator_review`. The latter must bind `module_sha256`, name `independent_reviewer`, and explicitly set `accepted_for_estimator_use:true`; this is not final card approval. `repair_origin.operations` enumerate exact `drawing`, `before_ascii`, `after_ascii`; its `mask_source` must equal the independently approved mask and the chain's `repair_mask_source`. Supply `stroke_config_2x` and `stroke_config_4x` with only `palette` and `masks`, using the exact transformed source footprint at each scale. Existing comparator defaults remain untouched.

Outputs distinguish `original-comparator-report.json` and `original-comparator-report-4x.json` from `corrected-style-report.json`. The corrected report preserves original width results and reports the stricter source-station maximum under the compatibility metric key `median_width_delta_px`, explicitly identified by `width_statistic`. It never calls the old width test a pass. The chain report binds both historical reports, each source/final stage, exact verifier hashes, composed expected PDFs and fresh actual1x/pairedrepair4x evidence. Its `release_ready:false` requires subsequent independent full card review.

For the combined project/critic contract, preserve the original addition-stage `topology_patch_review.plan_path/sha256` and `report_path/sha256`. Add `topology_patch_review.mixed_chain_review` containing `plan` and `report` file/hash records and `independent_visual_review`. That review must bind the actual final `artifact_sha256` and `chain_plan_sha256`, give source/region evidence, and explicitly confirm `independent`, `original_source_reviewed`, `addition_stage_reviewed`, `repair_stage_reviewed`, `actual_size_review_completed`, `paired_4x_review_completed`, and `no_visible_style_mismatch`. The ordinary topology visual review must also bind the actual final. The project preservation audit must bind the chain's distinct corrected-style report and map its numeric results to the existing repair mask, while retaining `contains_stroke_repair:true` and all unchanged style limits. Native additions keep their separate typed masks. `mixed_chain_contract.py` makes this explicit stage linkage mandatory; no intermediate artifact is presented as the final artifact.

Observed tests: T42 proposed final38c3e121… passes the isolated chain; twelve missing/stale/wrong-base/mask/style/omitted-status/disabled4x/rejected-review/threshold negatives fail. Source-bound estimator bitmap negatives cover broadening, narrowing, translation and missing status; actual PDF native width/narrowing/status mutations are rejected by exact native style proof. These are validation regressions, not final card approval or batch remeasurement. Evidence is retained in `territory-batch-12/gate-learning/{stem-width,mixed-chain}`. T65's earlier endpoint patch failed the isolated outside-mask test and remains unresolved until its own supported proof is run; this T42 fixture does not approve T65.
